issues.quote: T->>H: GET with X-Test-Subject, X-Test-Roles / H-->>T: no headers: 401 / H->>C: caller with sub and roles claims
issues.text: The 401 reply and the continuation to OrdersController.Get are drawn as one linear sequence, so the diagram reads as if the request is refused with 401 and then still reaches the controller. They are alternatives (no X-Test-Subject vs. headers present). Code: HandleAuthenticateAsync returns NoResult() and [Authorize] stops the request before Get; otherwise the caller reaches Get.
issues.fix: Wrap the two paths in an alt block: after `T->>H: GET ...` write `alt no X-Test-Subject` / `H-->>T: 401` / `else headers present` / `H->>C: caller with sub and roles claims` / `C->>O: AuthorizeAsync(caller, order)` / `O-->>C: not this customer's order` / `C-->>T: 403` / `end`.
